assessment_scope: Capability-gap signals in the supplied 12-entry sample only; ratings do not measure general model intelligence.

rules: A category with fewer than two relevant entries is Not measured.
Task volume is used only to establish whether a category is measured.
Weakness ratings require explicit friction such as correction, dissatisfaction, omission, or rework.
Covered means the category met the sample threshold without an explicit friction signal; it is not proof of broad competence.
Categories may overlap when an entry tests both a domain capability and tool execution.

strongest_measured_task_category.basis: Four relevant entries span implementation, debugging, refactoring, tests, and data migration, with no explicit friction signal in the sample. This is a relative result, not a claim of proven mastery.

category_ratings.evidence: One entry explicitly reports that source verification had previously been missed; the other research entries also require authoritative or primary-source citation.
